newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brent trading on SIMEX to move floors on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Brent trading on SIMEX to move floors on Monday.

text.p: The Brent crude trading pit on the Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) will move floors on Monday as part of efforts to save costs for brokers, industry sources said on Thursday.
The Brent pit, currently on the fourth floor, will drop down the the third floor, currently the most active floor in the exchange.
One source said the move would save costs for members because it would allow trading in several financial instruments to be focused on one pit.

Brent will be traded with the SIMEX fuel oil contract and various currency related contracts in the pit, the sources said. The move will also fit in with plans by SIMEX to introduce a gas oil contract, possibly later in the year. The contract is currently being developed by a group of company representatives from the industry, the sources said.
The fourth floor will be closed from Monday for renovation work that will take until the end of the year.
